summary: This directory manages TAR archive integration, providing both a high-level service interface and low-level streaming primitives to handle archive creation, content inspection, and selective data extraction.
responsibilities: Provide a unified service for archive operations
Stream and parse TAR archive content
Enable selective entry filtering and extraction
relationships: The TarService exposes high-level operations that delegate to underlying archive stream primitives.
Archive streams are filtered and parsed to support targeted extraction and validation tasks.
designDecisions: Streaming architecture for memory-efficient file processing
Facade pattern for exposing high-level service methods
Predicate-based filtering for selective data handling
